confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui tourist price levels for a July 2026 window; no live booking pages or listings were checked. Meal and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by beach area and season. Cocktail and wine were set at roughly two to two-and-a-quarter times the beer anchor because direct recall of Samui bar prices is less precise. The FX value comes from a search-result summary citing the RBA table; the live RBA page was not opened, so verify the rate before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Thai island and beach tourist pricing, positioned between mainland Krabi and Phuket levels, with Koh Phangan as the closest island comparable. Accommodation anchors assume July demand in main beach areas such as Chaweng, Lamai and Bophut.
